```{r, include = FALSE}
devtools::load_all()
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
db_path <- here::here("local","batch_test.db")
conn <- dbGetConn(db_path)
```

# Overall statistics

## Reviewed
```{r}
# Completed review status codes: -1 (flagged), 2 (legacy complete), 3 (extraction complete), 5 (scoring complete)
completed_codes <- c(-1L, 2L, 3L, 5L)

# Total evaluations reviewed (with at least one completed review_assignment)
tbl(conn, "review_assignment") |>
  filter(statusCode %in% completed_codes) |>
  distinct(evaluation_id) |>
  left_join(tbl(conn, "evaluation"), by = c("evaluation_id" = "id")) |>
  count(summary_flg, complete, name = "evaluations_reviewed") |>
  arrange(summary_flg, complete) |>
  collect() |>
  mutate(
    summary_flg = ifelse(summary_flg == 1, "Yes", "No"),
    complete = ifelse(complete == 1, "Yes", ifelse(is.na(complete), "Unknown", "No"))
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(col.names = c("Summary Evaluation", "Complete", "Evaluations Reviewed"))
```

## By clerkship
```{r}
tbl(conn, "review_assignment") |>
  filter(statusCode %in% completed_codes) |>
  distinct(evaluation_id) |>
  left_join(tbl(conn, "evaluation"), by = c("evaluation_id" = "id")) |>
  left_join(tbl(conn, "rotation"), by = c("rotation_id" = "id")) |>
  left_join(tbl(conn, "clerkship"), by = c("clerkship_id" = "id")) |>
  count(clerkship, name = "evaluations_reviewed") |>
  arrange(desc(evaluations_reviewed)) |>
  collect() |>
  knitr::kable(col.names = c("Clerkship", "Evaluations Reviewed"))
```

## By evaluator
```{r}
tbl(conn, "review_assignment") |>
  filter(statusCode %in% completed_codes) |>
  distinct(evaluation_id) |>
  left_join(tbl(conn, "evaluation"), by = c("evaluation_id" = "id")) |>
  left_join(tbl(conn, "evaluator"), by = c("evaluator_id" = "id")) |>
  group_by(evaluator) |>
  summarise(
    complete_regular = sum(ifelse(summary_flg == 0L, 1L, 0L), na.rm = TRUE),
    complete_summary = sum(ifelse(summary_flg == 1L, 1L, 0L), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(total = complete_regular + complete_summary) |>
  arrange(desc(total)) |>
  select(evaluator, complete_regular, complete_summary, total) |>
  collect() |>
  knitr::kable(col.names = c("Evaluator", "Regular", "Summary", "Total"))
```

## By student
```{r}
tbl(conn, "review_assignment") |>

  distinct(evaluation_id) |>
```

# Review scores

## By competency
```{r}
competency_names <- tibble::tribble(
  ~id, ~name,
  1L,  "Medical Knowledge",
  2L,  "Medical History Taking and Physical Examination",
  3L,  "Provide Effective Oral and Written Professional Communication",
  4L,  "Clinical Reasoning and Decision Making",
  5L,  "Interpersonal and Communication Skills",
  6L,  "Scholarly Inquiry and Evidence-Based Medicine Integration",
  7L,  "Professionalism",
  8L,  "Interprofessional and Team-Based Care"
)

result <- tbl(conn, "competency_score") |>
  left_join(tbl(conn, "review_assignment"), by = c("review_assignment_id" = "id")) |>
  filter(statusCode %in% completed_codes, !is.na(specificity)) |>
  group_by(competency_id) |>
  summarise(
    n      = n(),
    spec_avg = round(mean(specificity, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    spec_1 = sum(ifelse(specificity == 1L, 1L, 0L), na.rm = TRUE),
    spec_2 = sum(ifelse(specificity == 2L, 1L, 0L), na.rm = TRUE),
    spec_3 = sum(ifelse(specificity == 3L, 1L, 0L), na.rm = TRUE),
    spec_4 = sum(ifelse(specificity == 4L, 1L, 0L), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  collect() |>
  left_join(competency_names, by = c("competency_id" = "id")) |>
  arrange(competency_id) |>
  select(id = competency_id, name, n, spec_avg, spec_1, spec_2, spec_3, spec_4)

knitr::kable(result, col.names = c("ID", "Competency", "N", "Avg", "Score 1", "Score 2", "Score 3", "Score 4"))
```

# Ranking

```{r}
# Weights: coverage 35%, avg specificity 45%, utility 20%
w_c <- 0.35; w_s <- 0.45; w_u <- 0.20

comp_summary <- tbl(conn, "competency_score") |>
  filter(!is.na(specificity)) |>
  group_by(review_assignment_id) |>
  summarise(
    n_competencies  = n(),
    avg_specificity = mean(specificity, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ranking <- tbl(conn, "review_assignment") |>
  filter(statusCode == 5L) |>
  left_join(comp_summary, by = c("id" = "review_assignment_id")) |>
  left_join(tbl(conn, "evaluation"), by = c("evaluation_id" = "id")) |>
  left_join(tbl(conn, "evaluator"),  by = c("evaluator_id"  = "id")) |>
  left_join(tbl(conn, "rotation"),   by = c("rotation_id"   = "id")) |>
  left_join(tbl(conn, "clerkship"),  by = c("clerkship_id"  = "id")) |>
  filter(summary_flg == 0) |> 
  select(evaluation_id, evaluator, clerkship,
         utility, n_competencies, avg_specificity) |>
  collect() |>
  mutate(
    n_competencies   = ifelse(is.na(n_competencies), 0L, n_competencies),
    coverage_norm    = n_competencies / 8,
    specificity_norm = ifelse(n_competencies > 0, (avg_specificity - 1) / 3, 0),
    utility_norm     = (utility - 1) / 2,
    total_score      = round(
      (w_c * coverage_norm + w_s * specificity_norm + w_u * utility_norm) * 100, 1
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(total_score)) |>
  select(evaluation_id, evaluator, clerkship, n_competencies, avg_specificity, utility, total_score)

knitr::kable(
  ranking,
  col.names = c("Eval ID", "Evaluator", "Clerkship", "N Competencies", "Avg Specificity", "Utility", "Total Score"),
  digits    = c(0, 0, 0, 0, 2, 0, 1)
)
```

```{r}
dbFinish(conn)
```
